range.about: Any other span, white key to white key, e.g. "F3-F5"; wins over `keys`.

highlight.about: Keys to mark with a dot, e.g. "C4 E4 G4".

pulse.about: Breathe the dots (off under prefers-reduced-motion and `calm`).

calm.about: No motion at all: keys go down without travelling, dots don't breathe.

sound.about: Play real recordings when a key goes down (fetches the notes it needs, up to about 1.3 MB).

size.about: A multiple of 640px or any CSS length; unset fills the width.

pressed.about: Keys held down ("C4") and/or gamepad buttons read through `binding`.

binding.about: Gamepad button to note name, or "sustain", e.g. { south: "D4", rt: "sustain" }.
